title: Every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function of the 3-cube has at least 12 gates
formal_statement: ∀ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → (∀ x : Fin 8 → Bool, (C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin 8, (u.val, v.val) ∈ ([(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 4), (1, 3), (1, 5), (2, 3), (2, 6), (3, 7), (4, 5), (4, 6), (5, 7), (6, 7)] : List (ℕ × ℕ)) ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)) → 12 ≤ C.size
plain_statement: The graph is the 3-cube: u and v in 0..7 joined when their binary forms differ in exactly one bit; 12 edges, least vertex cover size 4. Every circuit of AND and OR gates only, each reading at most two wires, every gate counted, true on 8 inputs exactly when both ends of some edge are true, has at least 12 gates. Every such circuit has at least 11 gates and one through a cover has 15; this may be false: the opposite statement, a circuit with at most 11 gates, is its own row. A finite statement.
